transcript.en: Hello, Tourist Information Centre,
transcript.zh: 您好，旅游信息咨询中心，

transcript.en: Mike speaking, how can I help you?
transcript.zh: 我是Mike，请问需要什么帮助？

transcript.en: Oh, hi. I wanted to find out about cookery classes.
transcript.zh: 哦，你好。我想咨询一下烹饪课程的情况。

transcript.en: I believe there are some one-day classes for tourists?
transcript.zh: 听说有针对游客的一日制烹饪课程？

transcript.en: Well, they’re open to everyone,
transcript.zh: 这些课程对所有人开放，

transcript.en: but tourists are always welcome.
transcript.zh: 但特别欢迎游客参加。

transcript.en: OK, let me give you some details of what’s available.
transcript.zh: 好的，让我介绍一下现有课程。

transcript.en: There are several classes.
transcript.zh: 有几个不同的课程。

transcript.en: One very popular one is at the Food Studio.
transcript.zh: 其中很受欢迎的是Food Studio的课程。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: They focus on seasonal products,
transcript.zh: 他们专注于时令食材，

transcript.en: and as well as teaching you how to cook them,
transcript.zh: 不仅教烹饪方法，

transcript.en: they also show you how to choose them.
transcript.zh: 还会教如何挑选食材。

transcript.en: Right, that sounds good How big are the classes?
transcript.zh: 明白了，听起来不错。班级规模大吗？

transcript.en: I'm not sure exactly, but they'll be quite small.
transcript.zh: 具体人数不确定，但规模很小。

transcript.en: And could I get a private lesson there?
transcript.zh: 可以上私教课吗？

transcript.en: I think so ... let me check, yes, they do offer those.
transcript.zh: 让我查一下...是的，他们提供私教课。

transcript.en: Though in fact most of the people who attend the classes find it’s a nice way of getting to know one another.
transcript.zh: 不过大多数学员都觉得这是互相认识的好方式。

transcript.en: I suppose it must be, yes.
transcript.zh: 确实如此。

transcript.en: And this company has a special deal for clients where they offer a discount of 20 percent if you return for a further class.
transcript.zh: 这家机构对老客户有特别优惠：复购课程可享8折。

transcript.en: OK. But you said there were several classes?
transcript.zh: 好的。但你说还有其他课程？

transcript.en: That’s right.
transcript.zh: 对的。

transcript.en: Another one you might be interested in is Bond’s Cookery School.
transcript.zh: 另一个您可能感兴趣的是Bond烹饪学校。

transcript.en: They’re quite new, they just opened six months ago,
transcript.zh: 他们刚开业半年，

transcript.en: but I’ve heard good things about them,
transcript.zh: 但口碑很好，

transcript.en: they concentrate on teaching you to prepare healthy food,
transcript.zh: 专注健康饮食教学，

transcript.en: and they have quite a lot of specialist staff.
transcript.zh: 有专业师资团队。

transcript.en: So is that food for people on a diet and things like that?
transcript.zh: 这是指减肥餐之类的吗？

transcript.en: I don’t know if I’d be interested in that.
transcript.zh: 我不一定感兴趣。

transcript.en: Well, I don’t think they particularly focus on low calorie diets or weight loss.
transcript.zh: 应该不是专门的低卡路里或者减肥食物。

transcript.en: It’s more to do with recipes that look at specific needs,
transcript.zh: 更像是针对特定需求的食谱，

transcript.en: like including ingredients that will help build up your bones and make them stronger, that sort of thing.
transcript.zh: 比如强健骨骼的食材搭配。

transcript.en: I see. Well, I might be interested, I’m not sure.
transcript.zh: 明白了。我可能感兴趣，还不确定。

transcript.en: Do they have a website I could check?
transcript.zh: 他们有官网可以查看吗？

transcript.en: Yes, just key in the name of the school – it’ll come up.
transcript.zh: 有的，直接搜索学校名称就能找到。

transcript.en: And if you want to know more about them,
transcript.zh: 如果想了解更多，

transcript.en: every Thursday evening they have a lecture at the school.
transcript.zh: 每周四晚上7:30学校有讲座。

transcript.en: It’s free and you don’t need to book or anything,
transcript.zh: 免费的，无需预约，

transcript.en: just turn up at 7.30.
transcript.zh: 7点半准时参加就行。

transcript.en: And that might give you an idea of whether you want to go to an actual class.
transcript.zh: 去听一下能帮你判断是否报正课。

transcript.en: OK, there’s one more place you might be interested in.
transcript.zh: 还有一个地方您可能会感兴趣。

transcript.en: That’s got a rather strange name,
transcript.zh: 名字有点特别，

transcript.en: it’s called The Arretsa Centre - that’s spelled A-R-R-E-T-S-A.
transcript.zh: 叫Arretsa中心 - 拼写是A-R-R-E-T-S-A。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: They’ve got a very good reputation.
transcript.zh: 他们口碑很好。

transcript.en: They do a bit of meat and fish cookery but they mostly specialise in vegetarian dishes.
transcript.zh: 会教些肉类和鱼类的烹饪， 但主要专攻素食菜肴。

transcript.en: Right. That’s certainly an area. I’d like to learn more about.
transcript.zh: 正好，这正是我想多了解的领域。

transcript.en: I've got lots of friends who don't eat meat.
transcript.zh: 我有很多不吃肉的朋友。

transcript.en: In fact, I think I might have seen that school today.
transcript.zh: 其实我今天可能见过这所学校。

transcript.en: Is it just by the market?
transcript.zh: 是在市场旁边吗？

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: So they don't have any problem getting their ingredients.
transcript.zh: 所以他们获取食材很方便。

transcript.en: They’re right next door.
transcript.zh: 就在隔壁。

transcript.en: And they also offer a special two-hour course in how to use a knife.
transcript.zh: 他们还提供专门的2小时刀具使用课程。

transcript.en: They cover all the different skills: buying them, sharpening, chopping techniques.
transcript.zh: 涵盖所有相关技能：选购刀具、磨刀、切工技巧。

transcript.en: It gets booked up quickly though so you’d need to check it was available.
transcript.zh: 不过课程很抢手，您需要提前确认是否有名额。

transcript.en: Right, well thank you very much. I'll go and ...
transcript.zh: 好的，非常感谢。我会去看看...
